build.name: pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: pip install -q py_lets_be_rational . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: roundtrip (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)
runs.cmd: pip install -q py_lets_be_rational . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2 >/dev/null; python $HARNESS/roundtrip.py

notes: Oracle: price -> implied vol -> price round trip over a grid including deep OTM strikes closes to 1e-10 in sigma. py_lets_be_rational (Jaeckel's algorithm) is installed from PyPI at run time (recorded).
